previous_catalog_record.summary: 0-bg grid (large enough for expansion) with ONE nested two-color frame: outer ring is in OUTER color, inner solid is in INNER color (distinct from outer, both non-bg). Frame is square 4×4 to 7×7 typically, placed clear of grid borders so the expanded version fits. Rule: detect frame's outer color (top-left cell). Build a larger nested motif: outer ring of outer color, then inner ring of inner color, then core of outer color. The expanded motif is roughly 2× larger and centered at the original.
